name: EUR CoinVertible
oneLiner: EURCV is Societe Generale-FORGE's regulated euro stablecoin issued under the EU MiCA framework, designed for institutional on-chain settlement.
collateral: Euro-denominated cash deposits and high-quality securities held in a segregated fiduciary estate at Societe Generale, with daily public disclosure of reserve composition

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Societe Generale-FORGE publishes EURCV as an issuer-managed EMT across Ethereum, XRPL, Stellar, and Solana. No external bridge route is documented, so the reviewed route is regulated issuer-native issuance on supported chains.

mintAuthority.summary: EURCV Ethereum mint is gated by the registrar EOA (0x7de0bb…da69) embedded as an immutable in the SmartCoin V4 implementation; no proxy admin; XRPL/Stellar/Solana deployments are issuer-controlled and not separately scored.

controls.label: SG-FORGE issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: SG-FORGE product materials describe EURCV as directly issued and redeemable by SG-FORGE. On-chain, the registrar EOA is the sole minter (onlyAllowedMinter checks msg.sender == registrar). Issuer-backend model corroborated: registrar, operations, and technical are all SG-FORGE-operated EOAs embedded as immutables.

controls.label: EURCV Ethereum token proxy (SmartCoin V4)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294784: EIP-1967 impl = 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b (SmartCoin V4); proxy admin slot = zero (no external proxy admin). Implementation uses immutable operators set in constructor bytecode (verified via PUSH32 scan): registrar (minter) = 0x7de0bbdfcd4a6a956f149befcca30d6b5bc5da69 (EOA), operations = 0xc98cb9f53e20afbbeb75caf6456ed52d5d7903f6 (EOA), technical (upgrade admin) = 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955 (EOA). All confirmed via eth_getCode returning empty bytecode. Source: SmartCoin AccessControlUpgradeable.sol (Blockscout verified).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294784: SmartCoin V4 implementation confirmed; proxy admin slot zero; immutable operators extracted from implementation bytecode (PUSH32 pattern): registrar/minter = 0x7de0bbdfcd4a6a956f149befcca30d6b5bc5da69 (EOA), operations = 0xc98cb9f53e20afbbeb75caf6456ed52d5d7903f6 (EOA), technical/upgrade = 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955 (EOA). All EOAs confirmed. XRPL/Stellar/Solana are additional issuer-controlled deployments; scoped to Ethereum for this verification.
